external_user_email_uq.name: external_user_email_uq
external_user_email_uq.where: "external_user"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "external_user"."merged_into_id" IS NULL

issue_activity_owner_check.name: issue_activity_owner_check
issue_activity_owner_check.value: ("issue_activity"."issue_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("issue_activity"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

view_preferences_view_type_check.name: view_preferences_view_type_check
view_preferences_view_type_check.value: "view_preferences"."custom_view_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("view_preferences"."type" = 'user' AND "view_preferences"."view_type" IN ('allIssues', 'project', 'cycle', 'myIssues'))

webhook_scope_check.name: webhook_scope_check
webhook_scope_check.value: ("webhook"."team_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + "webhook"."all_public_teams"::int + ("webhook"."oauth_client_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1
